verdict.rationale: Chronicle publishes an API reference section covering authentication, reliability, and telemetry, with method-to-endpoint mappings such as events.search → POST /v1/search. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, which typically powers try-it consoles, all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable code examples within the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
